history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration explore improvements on the bank reconciliation transaction in Umoja.
history.administration_response: An Umoja business requirement change was created for the Enterprise Resource Planning Solution Division to explore through SAP updates that can be made to so that the open item indicator in the FEBAN module in Umoja matches that of the general ledger line item report. This change is in the process of being discussed with SAP (by the Division), and a further update was expected at the end of July 2024.
history.board_assessment: A revised alternative control has been provided to the Board regarding bank reconciliation for audit purposes. The work on the bank reconciliation transaction in Umoja is ongoing. The Board therefore considers the recommendation to be under implementation.

history.recommendation_text: In paragraph 379 of its report, the Board recommended that the Administration explore improvements on the bank reconciliation transaction in Umoja.

history.entities_raw: Department of Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance
history.sg_progress: SAP has confirmed that the standard functionality does not currently allow for the automatic updating of the open item indicator in the FEBAN module (transaction code in Umoja) on the basis of the status of the indicator at the general ledger line- item level. The Enterprise Resource Planning Solution Division has reiterated that the standard general ledger line-item report already provides bank reconcilers with the information needed regarding whether an item has been reconciled (cleared) and which document it was cleared by. SAP did respond that with the Umoja EHP8 upgrade, additional t-codes may be available. A risk analysis with regard to the use of these t-codes is currently being carried out by the Enterprise Resource Planning Solution Division and the Finance Division.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration explore improvements on the bank reconciliation transaction in Umoja.
history.administration_response: The Administration considers this recommendation to be implemented and requests its closure by the Board. The Administration has explored improvements in the bank reconciliation transaction and confirmed with the SAP that the current standard functionality did not support the automatic update of the open item flag. SAP also confirmed the availability of an updated T-code for the bank reconciliation process, which has been evaluated.
history.board_assessment: The Board considers that this recommendation has been overtaken by events because SAP confirmed the availability of an updated T-code regarding bank reconciliation but that the use of this new T-code is planned but not yet in use. The Board will follow up on the implementation of the new transaction.
